'''2007 Endor Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 10 March 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 Endor Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 10 March 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
